Forms for every stage of the SaaS user journey

Onboarding survey

Ask new users about their role, company size, and primary use case right after signup. Segment users from day one and trigger the right onboarding flow via Zapier → Intercom or HubSpot.

NPS & satisfaction

Run quarterly NPS surveys with automatic promoter/detractor routing. Detractors (0–6) get a follow-up question and a Slack alert to your CS team within seconds of submission.

Churn exit interview

Trigger a cancellation survey when a user downgrades or cancels. Collect the real reason — price, missing feature, switching to competitor — and send it straight to Slack for your product team.

Why SaaS teams use FormflowX

Built for product and growth teams

🔌

Plugs into your stack

HubSpot, Intercom, Salesforce, Segment, and 3,000+ more via Zapier. Onboarding data goes to your CRM automatically — no CSV imports.

🔀

Conditional routing

Show enterprise users different onboarding questions than solo users. Route churn reasons to different Slack channels. Every path is configurable.

💾

Partial submission capture

If a user starts your churn survey and closes the tab, you still capture their answers up to that point. Every data point counts for product decisions.

📉

Drop-off analytics

See which question causes users to abandon your onboarding survey. Fix the friction. Improve completion and the data quality of your user segmentation.

🤖

AI-generated forms

Describe the survey you need — "a churn exit interview for a B2B SaaS product" — and get a complete form in seconds. Edit to fit.

💸

No per-response fees

As your user base grows, your form costs don't. Pro is $15/month flat — no surprise bills when a survey gets high response rates.
